text:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of leads showing as "unassigned" for ~7–10m in HubSpot before the RR assignment kicks in. Can we add a small telemetry probe to measure real handoff latency?
Maya Chen: ugh that explains the weekend SLA blips. yes please. what metrics do we want?
Samir Patel: minimal: time from HS webhook received -> enrichment complete -> RR assignment -> first outbound activity (if any). sample rate 5% to start.
Priya Nair: agree. also track `owner=null` age and whether fallback to default owner triggered.
Alex Rivera: perfect. proposing an agent that emits a single line JSON event to our marketing-inbound topic. lightweight, no PII.
Maya Chen: sample event should include: lead_id (hashed), org_region, webhook_ts, enrich_done_ts, assign_ts, owner_type (rr|default|manual), fallback_reason.
Samir Patel: +1. add `route_path` (hubspot->api->rr) and `slo_breach` boolean relative to 2m assign target.
Priya Nair: weekend mode needs separate tag — `weekday_or_weekend`. weekdays vs weekend routing rules differ.
Alex Rivera: MVP payload sketch:
```
{"lead_hash":"sha256:xxxx","webhook_ts":1724753000,"enrich_done_ts":1724753050,"assign_ts":1724753100,"owner_type":"rr","slo_breach":false}
```
Maya Chen: love it. where will we surface this? a small dashboard in Console -> inbound-routing -> telemetry.
Samir Patel: I can wire a Grafana dashboard + Prometheus metrics exporter. events -> Kafka -> processor -> metrics.
Priya Nair: can we also surface per-connector heatmap? HubSpot vs Salesforce often have different patterns.
Alex Rivera: yes. and include an `enrichment_latency` histogram so Optimize team can recommend knob changes.
Maya Chen: operational concerns: sampling only for paid customers and opt-out via `metadata.skip_probe=true`. compliance check?
Priya Nair: legal ok as long as lead_id is hashed and no email/phone in payload. add `consent_flag:false|true`.
HubSpotBot: webhook received for portal 789 at 1724753012 (event id: hb_98765)
Samir Patel: scheduling: I can drop a small consumer + processor this week. Maya — can you add a ticket to the marketing backlog for the dashboard and deck?
Maya Chen: adding ticket: MKT-4327 — "Lead telemetry SLO calibration + dashboard". assign to @Samir and @Priya.
Alex Rivera: rollout plan proposal: 1) 5% sampling for 72h on staging, validate no PII, 2) 5% prod for 48h, watch breaches, 3) 25% for 1 week, then 100% sampling only on aggregated metrics, not raw events.
Priya Nair: suggest a canary rule: if average assign_ts-webhook_ts > 3m on canary, auto-disable sampling and notify oncall.
Maya Chen: add alert: `inbound.assign.latency.p95 > 180s` -> paging to ops.
Samir Patel: will include the canary in the processor. also unit tests for hashing.
Alex Rivera: small UX tweak: map `owner_type` values to human labels in dashboard and show fraction of default-owner fallbacks.
Priya Nair: OK. next step: Samir to push PR with processor, Maya to create dashboard ticket, Alex to draft a 1-pager for sales about improved SLA visibility.
Maya Chen: timeline?
Samir Patel: PR by EOD Thu (1724825600), staging run Fri, prod canary Mon.
Alex Rivera: thanks team. leaving a note: if we see rr fairness drift after telemetry we should run the fairness replay job with shorter jitter.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with the ticket and tag infra for Kafka throughput.
Priya Nair: thanks — will check compliance once PR appears.
HubSpotBot: connector webhook backlog: 2 pending retries for portal 789
Alex Rivera: noted. will include backlog metric in dashboard as well.
Maya Chen: great. closing thread — we'll reconvene post-staging run to decide threshold tweaks. :rocket:
